500071.name: Branč

The only okrsky document online is the mayor's decision No. OÚ-200-5/2026 of 9 July 2026 for the elections of 24 October 2026 (okrsok 1 = part Branč, okrsok 2 = part Veľká Ves), which is not valid for this vote. The Internet Archive stayed offline (connection refused / 'Temporarily Offline') across repeated retries over about 20 minutes, so archived pages could not be checked. Web search found nothing.

500372.name: Jelenec
500372.note: The mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of 22.06.2023 (on https://www.jelenec.sk/obecny-urad/volby-a-referenda/narodnej-rady-sr-2023/) names only the polling room of each of the 2 okrsky, not their territory; the municipality has a single part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn.

500470.name: Lúčnica nad Žitavou
500470.note: The NR SR 2023 page links 'Utvorerenie volebných okrskov Lúčnica nad Žitavou' (DOCX: 'Obec Lúčnica nad Žitavou má utvorené 2 volebné okrsky. Okrsok č. 1 – zasadačka OcÚ Lúčnica nad Žitavou – Vajka nad Žitavou; Okrsok č. 2 – obecný dom Martinová'), but the document is undated and does not name the vote, the page gives no posting date, and the Internet Archive's first capture of the page is of 2023-10-03, after the vote; so it cannot be dated to this vote under the rules.

500577.name: Mojmírovce
500577.note: The municipality's current website (new CMS, notice board from 2025) holds only 2026 election documents; the old website (WEBY GROUP CMS) is gone and only partly in the Internet Archive, which has no capture of the notice board or elections page from the weeks before this vote (the National Council election 2023), and no okrsky document for it (the 'Voľby a referendá' page captured 2018–2024 lists only old results). Only the 2017 (Voľby 2017 page) and 2026 (referendum) okrsky documents were found. Nor was the referendum of 21 January 2023's document found to stand in.

500640.name: Nové Sady
500640.note: The municipality's page for this vote (live, or as archived) lists only the announcement of the vote, voter information, e-mail addresses and results; no okrsky document. Okrsky documents exist only for the referendum 2023, EP 2024 and referendum 2026 (okrsok 1 Nové Sady, Kotrbál, Ceroviny; okrsok 2 Sila).

500941.name: Výčapy-Opatovce
500941.note: The only okrsky document found (Utvorenie volebných okrskov for the referendum of 4 July 2026, 05.05.2026) creates 2 okrsky with both polling rooms in the hall of the Kultúrny dom, Opatovská 204/1, without saying which addresses belong to which okrsok (the voters are split about equally, evidently by voter list); the other votes' pages (live and in the Internet Archive) list no okrsky document. No rules can be written.

501034.name: Bajč
501034.note: The mayor's document for this vote (https://web.archive.org/web/20231004122506/https://www.bajc.sk/e_download.php?file=data/editor/126sk_4.pdf&original=utvorenie%20volebn%C3%BDch%20okrskov.pdf) lists only the 3 okrsky with their polling stations (č. 1 Bajč – Kultúrny dom, č. 2 Chrasť – bývalé pohostinstvo, č. 3 Vlkanovo – Komunitné centrum), no streets or parts; the municipality has 5 parts (Bajč, Chrasť, Kotelnica, Nový Diel, Vlkanovo), so okrsky are fewer than parts and the parts Kotelnica and Nový Diel cannot be assigned from the document; per the rules this is not_found.

501140.name: Hurbanovo
501140.note: The town's current website has election pages only for EP 2024, referendum 2026 and the 2026 elections; earlier pages (old site hurbanovo.sk/obcan/volby-…) survive only in the Internet Archive, which was unreachable (connection refused / 503). Live site also rate-limited (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

501174.name: Iža
501174.note: Iža's okrsky decisions on its notice board (NR SR 2023 of 23.06.2023, president 2024 of 23.01.2024, EP 2024 of 22.02.2024) only create okrsky 1 and 2, both in the Obecný dom (zasadacia miestnosť / galéria), without saying which addresses vote in which; the register has no streets, so no rules can be written. No 2017–2020 okrsky document is on the board. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

501239.name: Marcelová
501239.note: Found the vote's 'Informácia o vytvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností' on the website. The document gives each okrsok only its polling station (okrsky 1 and 2 both in the Kultúrny dom, súp. č. 1161; okrsok 3 in the Materská škola, Námestie slobody 1395), with no streets or parts; the municipality has 3 okrsky but only 2 parts (Marcelová, Krátke Kesy), and two stations share one building, so the okrsky cannot be placed from it.

501395.name: Bátorove Kosihy
501395.note: The website keeps only 2026 election files; the only okrsky document found (for the municipal elections of October 2026) names 3 okrsky all in the cultural house no. 1263 with no addresses per okrsok, and the village is a single part with no streets, so no rules can be drawn even from it. The Internet Archive (online) holds no okrsky document of this vote (its 2018-2020 captures of the elections page files are candidate lists and voter information).

501522.name: Veľký Meder
501522.note: No okrsky document of the NR SR election 2023 found on the website (search and notice board); Internet Archive offline.

501573.name: Gabčíkovo
501573.note: The city's document for this vote ("Zverejnenie informácie práva voliť a práva byť volený, vytvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre voľby do NR SR v roku 2023", okrsky.jpg, dated 26.06.2023) creates okrsky 1-4 but names for each only its polling station, all four in the same building (ZŠ L. Amadého s VJM, Komenského 1081/1, B budova, different classrooms); it lists no streets, house numbers or parts. Gabčíkovo has a single part and k.ú., so the okrsky cannot be placed by part either (prompt: station-only documents are usable only where okrsky equal parts with stations in different parts). No other document of the city (live elections pages 2020-2026, archived Joomla site 2017-2022) lists the okrsky's streets.

501590.name: Horná Potôň
501590.note: NR SR 2023: only voter information (item 279) and e-mail addresses; no okrsky document. The current site's elections section (live and archived records, categories NR SR 2020, NR SR 2023, referendum 2023, prezident 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026) holds only voter information, e-mail addresses and minutes for these votes; the only okrsky document is "N-9-volebné okrsky.doc" of 2022 (3 okrsky, places only), which is another vote's.

501603.name: Horný Bar
501603.note: No okrsky determination for the National Council election of 30 September 2023 on the obec's website: the notice board archive (all records from 2015) lists no "utvorenie volebných okrskov" for this vote; its 2023 notice (id 235) gives only the delegation address; then the OVK minutes. The site search for "okrsk" finds only the 2026 notices. The Internet Archive (CDX API) was unreachable at the time, so archived copies could not be checked.

501719.name: Kútniky
501719.note: The website (a Joomla site listing its notices as PDFs on the home page) never posted an okrsky document except for the 2022 elections (and 2026): the archived home pages of 2021-2026 list for the referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024 and the referendum 2026 only voter information, e-mail notices and commission minutes; the Internet Archive has nothing of 2017-2020 elections and the live site keeps only 2025-2026 notices.

501735.name: Lehnice
501735.note: The municipality (2 okrsky, 5 parts, no streets) publishes no utvorenie volebných okrskov with their territory on its website, live or archived; the NR SR 2023 page names only the polling station of each okrsok (Okrsok č. 1: Kultúrny dom Lehnice č. 58; Okrsok č. 2: Školská jedáleň Lehnice č. 839), not their territory; 2 okrsky vs 5 parts, so no part per station can be inferred.

501743.name: Lúč na Ostrove
501743.note: The obec's Voľby page (live, and as the Internet Archive kept it in 2019 and 2022) has a category "Voľby do Národnej rady Slovenskej republiky v roku 2023" but no decision on the okrsky and polling stations for this vote: only the announcement of the vote, the e-mail address for delegating commission members, the Ministry's information for voters (generic, no okrsky) and, for elections, candidate lists or commission minutes. The live notice board is empty and none of its archived documents (old e_download.php and data/uredni_deska files, file_storage downloads in the CDX) concerns the okrsky. The only okrsky decision the website has is the one for the municipal and regional elections of 24 October 2026 (download.php?file=4486d01c|545), which is not this vote's. The Internet Archive answered. A web search for the okrsky of Lúč na Ostrove found nothing else.

501808.name: Nový Život
501808.note: The website's pages of the votes (news items 'Voľby …', 'Referendum 2026') link no okrsky document of the 2023 NR SR vote (only results, minutes, voter information); the notice board keeps only current items; the only okrsky document on the site is that of the elections of 24 October 2026. The Internet Archive's web.archive.org refused every connection for over 30 minutes (only the availability API answered), so no archived pages or documents could be read.
tried: https://www.novyzivot.sk/evt_file.php?file=2288 … 2330 (unlinked files of spring 2026, by file name)

501824.name: Okoč
501824.note: The 2023 National Council election page has only the information for voters and the delegation e-mail; the referendum 2023 page has no okrsky document either. No okrsky document found.
tried: https://www.okoc.sk/e_download.php?file=data/uredni_deska/obsah1_1.pdf … obsah400_1.pdf (every file of the notice board, 244 found, none on okrsky)

501859.name: Orechová Potôň
501859.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The current website (since about 2024) has no elections page; its notice board (all 10 pages) lists for elections only the 2026 municipal/regional notices (candidates, commission, obvody). The Internet Archive's CDX of orechovapoton.sk (2016–2026) lists the old site's election pages (information for voters, e-mail addresses, the 2018 page stating 'Počet okrskov: 2') and result records, but no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' or list of streets per okrsok. The Internet Archive was offline at times but answered after retries.

502006.name: Vrakúň
502006.note: The live site keeps only the October 2026 okrsky notice (okrsok 1 časť obce Vrakúň, okrsok 2 časť obce Nekyje na Ostrove). The Internet Archive's captures of vrakun.sk (CDX 2017–2026) hold no okrsky document of 2017, 2018, 2019 or 2020 and none for 2024 (the 2024 elections pages and the one PDF retrievable hold only e-mail notices; other captures failed to load). For the NR SR election of 30 September 2023 the archive has 'Vytvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (Vo Vrakúni 23.06.2023): 2 okrsky, both voting in the obecný úrad, Nám. sv. Štefana 474/1; it names no parts or streets, and with both stations in one building the okrsky cannot be told apart, so no rules can be written.

502022.name: Zlaté Klasy
502022.note: The municipality has an elections page for each vote (live and in the Internet Archive), but none of them links an okrsky document (they hold the information for voters, delegation forms and the okrsky commissions' minutes). The only okrsky document found, "rozdelenie ulíc do okrskov" (evt_file.php?file=7010), is on the page of the 2022 municipal and regional elections, a vote not among these.

502031.name: Levice
502031.note: The live website's election pages list only results (minutes per okrsok) for this vote, no mayor's okrsky document; the úradná tabuľa (CG eGOV) shows only current postings. The Internet Archive's CDX for levice.sk answered 504/timeouts for most years over ~20 minutes of retries (only 2018 and 2020 lists came back, without okrsky documents); its captures of the old elections pages hold no okrsky notice. The council's obvody resolution of 02.08.2018 lists 47 okrsky but is no document of this vote.

502421.name: Kozárovce
502421.note: The 2023 NRSR document (doc_230614.pdf, 12.06.2023) exists but gives only the polling station. Kozárovce has one part and no streets (1005 addresses by súpisné číslo); its okrsky documents (2022, 2023 NRSR, 2024 EP) only state that there are 2 okrsky, both voting in ZŠ s MŠ Kozárovce č. 927, without any addresses or house numbers per okrsok, so no split of the village can be written or inferred.

502642.name: Plášťovce
502642.note: The live website has no elections section; its notice board and archive reach back only to spring 2026 and hold no okrsky document. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org CDX API) stayed offline (HTTP 503 / connection failures) for over 20 minutes of retries with pauses, so archived pages of earlier votes could not be searched.

502693.name: Pukanec
502693.note: The website has no elections section; the notice board lists only current items, the per-vote pages found (presidential 2024, referendum 2026) are gone (404) and the referendum 2023 page no longer links documents. The host also rate-limits (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

502821.name: Tekovské Lužany
502821.note: Every okrsky notice on the website (president 2019 of 30.01.2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023 of 22.06.2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026 of 24.04.2026) only gives the number of okrsky (3) and their polling stations (Obecný úrad SNP 43, Základná škola J. A. Komenského 37, bývalá MŠ Družstevná 87), not which streets vote where; the municipality has a single part, so no okrsok can be inferred from its station. No 2017 or 2018 okrsky document is on the site. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

503185.name: Gbelce
503185.note: The website has no elections section; the notice board and news list only items from 2024 on (the EP 2024 item is the only one with an okrsky document; the referendum 2026 item has results only). Host rate-limits (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

503321.name: Lipová
503321.note: The current website keeps election documents only for the October 2026 elections (and results of the 2026 referendum); no okrsky document of this vote and no older election pages. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

503380.name: Veľký Kýr
503380.note: The municipality's document register (searched for "okrsk" and "miestnost") has okrsky documents only of 2024 and 2026, none of the NR SR election 2023; Internet Archive offline.

503401.name: Mužla
503401.note: The archived "Voľby 2023" page links "Volebné okrsky" (wp-content/uploads/2023/06/volebne-okrsky.docx), but the Internet Archive has no capture of that file and it is gone (404) live. The website was rebuilt in 2025; its older files are gone (404) and the Internet Archive kept neither this vote's okrsky document nor the pages listing it.

503550.name: Strekov
503550.note: The live and archived (Internet Archive) pages of the vote on strekov.sk list no okrsky document, only information, the law, e-mail notices and the commissions' minutes; the notice board has none either. NR SR 2023 page: law, info SK/HU, minutes, e-mail notice only. Internet Archive was intermittently offline but answered after retries.

503568.name: Svodín
503568.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The live elections page has only the 2026 municipal documents (with the 2026 okrsky list); the 2026 referendum notice has only the commission records; the site search for 'okrsk' finds nothing older. The Internet Archive's captures of the old (WordPress) and new site's election pages and notices (2017, 2018, 2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023) list voters' information, postal vote, e-mail and council-size notices, but no okrsky document, and its CDX of svodin.sk has no okrsky file.

503592.name: Šurany
503592.note: The elections pages list okrsky documents only for the referendums of 2023 and 2026 and the 2026 elections; no okrsky document of the National Council election of 2023 (its page has only the okrsky records of results) found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

503614.name: Tvrdošovce
503614.note: No okrsky document with streets found. The municipality's election pages (old site, live at archiv.tvrdosovce.sk/informacie/volby, 2013-2024; new site tvrdosovce.sk/volby.html from 2026) give for 2017 and 2023 only the polling stations of the 4 okrsky (ZŠ Nová cesta; Obecný/Kultúrny dom for 2 and 3; MŠ Hlboká), with no streets, and for the other votes no okrsky notice at all; the Internet Archive's index adds nothing. With one part and 4 okrsky the split cannot be inferred.

503649.name: Zemné
503649.note: The archived NR SR 2023 article links "Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov .pdf", but it is gone live (404) and not in the Internet Archive.

503711.name: Diakovce
503711.note: The website's elections section has pages only for NR SR 2020 (voter information, e-mail address, call — no okrsky), 2022 and 2026; no okrsky document for this vote. The Internet Archive was flaky/refusing connections during the search.

503746.name: Dolné Saliby
503746.note: The municipality's okrsky documents found (2022-11, 2023-06-26, 2024-01-19, 2026-07-30; scans) only create 'Volebný okrsok č. 1' and 'Volebný okrsok č. 2' with one shared polling room (Kultúrny dom 482, later Dolné Saliby 479); none says which addresses or voters belong to which okrsok (the register has no streets, all 887 addresses in one part; the split is evidently by voter list, e.g. alphabetical), so no rules can be written. No document of 2017-2020 found on the website (WordPress search for okrsky/volebná miestnosť); the Internet Archive CDX query did not answer.

503771.name: Horné Saliby
503771.note: Horné Saliby publishes a decision on okrsky per vote on its elections pages (hornesaliby.sk/samosprava/volby/), but the pages kept are those of 2022 (archive), the presidential and EP elections of 2024 and the referendum 2026; the pages of this vote (where they exist, e.g. NR SR 2023, referendum 2023) link no okrsky document. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

503835.name: Jelka
503835.note: The 'Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov a o určení volebných miestností' of 2023 gives only: 3 okrsky; okrsok 1 Základná škola Školská 399/1 large gym, okrsok 2 same school small gym, okrsok 3 Zdravotné stredisko Hlavná 760/104. No streets, so no rules can be written (3 okrsky, 1 part; two stations in the same building).

503959.name: Pata
503959.note: No okrsky notice for this vote: the live election pages (2024 presidential and EP) and every archived elections page of obecpata.sk (2018–2024, captured before the votes) carry only the announcement and voter information, no 'oznámenie o vytvorení volebných okrskov'; the site publishes the okrsky (by súpisné číslo) only on the 2022 and 2026 pages. Another vote's notice is not this vote's.

504025.name: Šaľa
504025.note: The town's article for this vote (Internet Archive) links the okrsky document ('04a Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností - SJ', component_file 6018/f5178), but the Internet Archive has no copy of the PDF (requests return its 'not found' page) and the live file cannot be fetched. The town's website answers 'Access Forbidden' to our requests, so only Internet Archive copies could be used.

504068.name: Tešedíkovo
504068.note: Found 'Vytvorenie volebných okrskov pre voľby do NR SR konané dňa 30.09.2023' (č. 563/2/2023, 19.6.2023, scan obsah1116_3.pdf), but it names only the three polling stations. Every okrsky document Tešedíkovo published (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) gives each of its 3 okrsky only its polling station (Dom kultúry č. 860; MŠ č. 153; Školská jedáleň ZŠ č. 974), never which houses vote where. The municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so the okrsky cannot be placed or inferred from the stations (the prompt's part-inference needs as many parts as okrsky).

504106.name: Trstice
504106.note: The mayor's document for the National Council election of 30 September 2023 (notice-board item 247 'Voľby do NRSR 30.9.2023', posted 19.7.2023, https://www.trstice.sk/e_download.php?file=/data/uredni_deska/obsah247_1.pdf) only forms 3 okrsky and names their polling stations (1. Obecný úrad č. 667, 2. Komunitný dom č. 1322, 3. Základná škola č. 647); it gives no house numbers or other territory per okrsok. Trstice has a single part and no streets (all addresses are súpisné čísla), so a list of polling stations alone cannot be turned into rules (3 okrsky, 1 part). Every item of the official notice board (úradná tabuľa, items 1–444, 2016–2026, incl. the items migrated from the old Joomla site) was listed by id and every election item opened; the Internet Archive (CDX of trstice.sk, old site trstice.sk/sk/aktuality/…) was searched for election pages and radio announcements (hlásenie miestneho rozhlasu) around the vote; the IA was slow and often refused connections, but the pages listed in tried were retrieved.

504122.name: Veľká Mača
504122.note: Veľká Mača's okrsky documents (2023 NRSR, 2024 president, 2024 EP, 2026 municipal/regional) only create 2 okrsky and name their polling stations, both in the same building (Obecný úrad, Sereďská 137: zasadačka / sobášna sieň); none assigns streets or house numbers. The municipality has one part and no street names, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from stations. No 2017–2022 documents are on the site and the Internet Archive has no captures of velkamaca.sk for 2017–2022.

504131.name: Veľké Úľany
504131.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (2024 presidential, 2026) give only the four polling stations, all in the same part (Veľké Úľany, Hlavná 579/8 and 578/9), with no streets or parts per okrsok; no document with streets is on the website, and the Internet Archive keeps only the old frames site (no election documents for 2017–2023).

504203.name: Senica
504203.note: The city's election articles are reused for each new vote (the municipal and regional pages now show 2026 only), so this vote's documents are no longer linked; older files survive only under unknown article/file ids. The Internet Archive's CDX was offline ('Temporarily Offline', HTTP 503) for over 15 minutes, so archived copies could not be searched.

504238.name: Borský Mikuláš
504238.note: No notice of the 2023 NR SR election okrsky found on the website or in the Internet Archive (the obec's host also rate-limits us).

504254.name: Brestovec
504254.note: This vote's document was found, but The okrsky documents of 2023 (referendum, NR SR), 2024 (president, EP) and the 2026 referendum give only the two polling stations (zasadačka OcÚ/KD Brestovec 189/273; kancelária PD Poriadie 412) and no osady, house numbers or streets; Brestovec is one part without streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from them.

504351.name: Gbely
504351.note: The page 'Volebné okrsky a miestnosti NRSR' has the document for the National Council election 2023: 4 okrsky, each 'ZŠsMŠ Gbely', Pionierska 697, with no streets. Gbely (4 okrsky in 3 parts: Gbely, Adamov, Cunín) publishes for each vote only 'Volebné okrsky a miestnosti': every okrsok with its polling station, all of them in the same building (ZŠ s MŠ Gbely, Pionierska 697), with no streets or parts. Such a document cannot be turned into rules (the stations do not lie in different parts, and the okrsky outnumber the parts), so per the prompt this is not_found; no street list of the okrsky was found on the website or by web search.

504416.name: Jablonica
504416.note: The NR 2023 page lists only the commissions' minutes; no okrsky document. The okrsky documents of this municipality (2015/16, 2022, 2024) define the two okrsky by street names (okrsok 1: Červenej armády, Dúbrava, Hurbanova, …; okrsok 2: Bernolákova, Bosý Jarok, Brezie, …), but the address register has no streets for Jablonica (all 946 addresses are without a street, one part, one k.ú.), so no rule can select those streets and the document cannot be turned into valid rules without guessing.

504769.name: Rohožník
504769.note: No document of this vote assigning addresses to okrsky found live or in the Internet Archive. The only Rohožník document with an address split is the 2024 presidential one (súpisné čísla 1–381 / 382–395 / 396–800, dated 24.1.2024); other okrsky documents on the site (e.g. the NR SR 2020 / 2026 'Určenie volebných okrskov') list only the polling station (all three in the same school), so they cannot place addresses.

504891.name: Šaštín-Stráže
504891.note: Šaštín-Stráže publishes for each vote only the addresses of the polling stations (e.g. "Adresy volebných okrskov pre Referendum v r. 2026": okrsok 1 ZŠ Hviezdoslavova 1462 in Stráže, okrsky 2 and 3 both in the Mestský úrad, Alej 549, Šaštín); no document says which streets of Šaštín belong to okrsok 2 or 3, so no rules can be written. Older votes' pages are gone from the new website, and the Internet Archive stayed unreachable (CDX timeouts / connection refused) during the search.

504998.name: Topoľčany
504998.note: The archived notice 'Parlamentné voľby 2023' (IA capture of 12 Jul 2023) links 'Volebne_okrsky_a_volebne_miestnosti_v_meste_Topolcany.pdf' (download_file_f.php?id=1881506), but the file is gone from topolcany.sk (HTTP 404) and the Internet Archive has no copy. The Internet Archive's CDX timed out or answered 'Temporarily Offline' for most queries (2017, 2019 never answered; 2018, 2020 returned nothing).

505048.name: Ludanice
505048.note: The website's pages for 2017–2020 hold only results; the NR SR 2023 and presidential 2024 posts (archived) link 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' PDFs that are now 404 and were not captured by the Internet Archive; the 2023 referendum post has no okrsky document; nothing for the 2026 referendum besides results.

505421.name: Radošina
505421.note: No page or document of the National Council election of 30 September 2023 found on the new website (live or archived) or on archiv.radosina.sk.

505498.name: Solčany

505722.name: Veľké Uherce

505943.name: Dolná Súča

505960.name: Drietoma

506010.name: Horná Súča
506010.note: The municipality's okrsky documents (referendum 2023 of 09.11.2022, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024, referendum 2026 of 06.05.2026) give each of the 6 okrsky only its polling station (1 knižnica č. 233 and 2 MŠ č. 235 both in Horná Súča, 3 Dúbrava, 4 Závrská, 5 Vlčí Vrch, 6 Trnávka); the municipality has 7 parts (Dolná/Horná Závrská, Krásny Dub, ...) and two okrsky lie in part Horná Súča, so the okrsky cannot be given by the parts of their stations, and no document says which addresses vote where.

506036.name: Horné Srnie
506036.note: The NR SR 2023 page lists no okrsky document.

506150.name: Krajné
506150.note: The decisions for the 2023 referendum (10.11.2022), NR SR 2023 (23.06.2023), presidential 2024 (26.01.2024) and EP 2024 (01.03.2024) give each okrsok only its polling station (okrsok 1: Obecný úrad Krajné, okrsok 2: Kultúrny dom Matejovec), without houses or parts; the municipality has 6 parts for 2 okrsky, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from the stations. No okrsky document for 2017–2020 or the 2026 referendum is on the website.

506427.name: Podolie
506427.note: This vote's document was found but cannot be turned into rules: The only okrsky document with two okrsky (NR SR 30.9.2023) says "Okrsok č.1 Obec Podolie; Okrsok č. 2 Podolie – časť Kopanice" without house numbers; Kopanice is not a part, street or k.ú. in the register (one part Podolie, no streets, addresses only by súpisné číslo), so okrsok 2 cannot be drawn without guessing its houses.

506508.name: Soblahov
506508.note: Soblahov has no streets and one part (804 addresses by súpisné číslo). Its elections pages (2017-2026) hold no okrsky document with addresses; the one it publishes ("Utvorenie volebných okrskov s vymedzením ich územného obvodu", 2022) says only that 2 okrsky are formed, both voting in the Obecný úrad Soblahov 470, without saying which houses belong to which; so no rules can be written.

506559.name: Trenčianska Teplá
506559.note: The website's election pages (2022–2026) hold only OVK minutes and results, no okrsky announcement for this vote; the referendum 2026 page links a file on trencin.sk (another municipality's website), not usable. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

506613.name: Trenčianske Teplice
506613.note: The city's election pages give the okrsky for 2018, 2019, 2024 and 2026, but the 2017 regional elections page (archived 30.8.2017) and the NR SR 2023 page (live and archived 29.6.2023) list no okrsky, and no NR SR 2020 page is archived.

506842.name: Brestovany
506842.note: Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov … pre voľby do NR SR (scan, 2023). The document creates 2 okrsky but gives each only its polling station (okrsok 1: Kultúrny dom, okrsok 2: malá sála obecného úradu, both at J. Nižnanského 474/6 in Brestovany), no streets or parts. The municipality has 2 parts (Brestovany, Horné Lovčice) but both stations lie in the same building in Brestovany, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations' parts.

506851.name: Bučany
506851.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (live: referendum 2026, 12.5.2026; archived: presidential 2024, 19.1.2024; referendum 2023, 14.11.2022) name only the polling rooms of okrsok 1 and 2 (Kultúrny dom and Dom služieb, both on Námestie sv. Floriána), with no streets; Bučany has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The archived pages of 2018, 2019, 2020 and EP 2024 have no okrsky document; the NR SR 2023 page could not be fetched from the Archive.

506923.name: Dolná Krupá
506923.note: The website (search for okrsky/určenie/miestností, the 2023 and 2024 election news pages) has okrsky documents only for 2022, the 2024 presidential and EP elections and the 2026 votes; the NR SR 2023 news page names only 'dva volebné okrsky' in the cultural centre. No okrsky document of this vote. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

506991.name: Drahovce
506991.note: The archived page links no okrsky document; only the commissions' minutes of 2023 are archived.

507032.name: Hlohovec
507032.note: The city's page of the NR SR 2023 elections now links only the 18 okrsok commissions' minutes; no okrsky document of that vote is on the website. The Internet Archive's web.archive.org refused every connection for over 30 minutes (only the availability API answered), so no archived pages or documents could be read.

507067.name: Horné Orešany
507067.note: No NRSR 2023 page or okrsky document on the website (the NRSR page holds 2020 voter information only).

507121.name: Chtelnica
507121.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (referendum 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026) only state "utváram volebný okrsok č. 1 a volebný okrsok č. 2" with one polling station (Základná škola, Námestie 1. mája 3) for both; they never say which streets vote where, and Chtelnica has one part, so no rules can be written. For this vote not even such a notice is on the notice board (archive of all notices checked).

507199.name: Kočín-Lančár
507199.note: No document on the okrsky of this vote: the page has only the voter information. (The okrsky are presumably Kočín and Lančár as in the council obvody, but no document of this vote says so.)

507288.name: Madunice
507288.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The live elections page (Voľby a referendum) keeps only the 2026 notices (Referendum 04.07.2026, Spojené voľby 2026). Its capture of 2022-03-19 lists for 2017–2020 only candidate lists, voters' information, the decisions calling elections, the commission delegation and the results; no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' or street list. The Internet Archive's CDX of madunice.sk (2017–2026) has no other election notice, and no capture of the page between 2022 and 2025 lists the 2022–2024 votes. The host (webygroup) was fetched sparingly because of its rate limit.

507296.name: Majcichov
507296.note: This vote's document was found (archived 2023-06-28): 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre voľby do NR SR', dated 26.06.2023. It creates 2 okrsky but gives each only its polling station (both in the Kultúrny dom, Majcichov 606, doors 1 and 2), with no split of the addresses; the municipality has a single part, so the station-per-part inference does not apply. No other 2023 document on the page (captures of 2023-06-28, 2023-08-30, 2023-09-27). The referendum of 21 January 2023 had 1 okrsok only (notice of 10.11.2022), so it cannot stand in. The presidential notice of 22.01.2024 splits by súpisné číslo 1–415 / 416–880, but it is a later vote's document.

507555.name: Smolenice
507555.note: The mayor's decision for the NR SR election of 2023 (27.6.2023) gives the 3 okrsky only their polling stations (two in Kultúrny dom Smolenice, one in Smolenická Nová Ves), no streets; with 2 parts and 3 okrsky the okrsky cannot be placed from it.

507571.name: Suchá nad Parnou
507571.note: No document assigning house numbers to okrsky for this vote: the notice board (suchanadparnou.sk/samosprava/uradna-tabula, live and in the Internet Archive) has for the EP elections 2019 only the mayor's decision naming two rooms in the cultural house (no split), and for the regional elections 2017, the NRSR elections 2023 and the referendum 2026 no okrsky notice or decision; the elections section keeps pages only for 2024.

507601.name: Špačince
507601.note: The municipality's elections pages hold only results and candidate lists (2018–2020) or link to the ministry's website (2023–2024); no okrsky document of any vote was found on the website, its notice archive, or in the Internet Archive (CDX returned nothing).

507636.name: Šúrovce
507636.note: The website's elections page and notice board (current and archive) hold only 2026 documents; no okrsky document of this vote found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

507709.name: Veľké Kostoľany
507709.note: Every okrsky document of Veľké Kostoľany found (prezident 2024 of 29.01.2024, EP 2024 of 29.02.2024, referendum 2026, municipal 2026 of 14.07.2026) only names 2 okrsky with one polling station (sála kultúrneho domu) and does not say which streets or houses vote in which okrsok; no document of 2017-2023 found live. The Internet Archive (CDX) stayed offline on repeated attempts over ~20 minutes, so archived pages for this vote could not be checked.

507768.name: Zavar
507768.note: The 2023 National Council election page (archived 2023-09-23) links 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností' (wp-content/uploads/2023/06/...), but the file is gone from the website and the Internet Archive's only capture of it (2024-08-04) is a 404 page.

507849.name: Budmerice
507849.note: The Webygroup website keeps no elections page; its notice board and announcements now list only items of late 2026, and the site search finds no okrsky document of this vote (only the 2026 municipal elections' minutes). The Internet Archive (CDX API and web.archive.org) was unreachable for over 20 minutes, so archived copies could not be checked.

507890.name: Gajary
507890.note: Gajary publishes for each vote only "informácia o počte volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností": 2 okrsky, both in the Obecný úrad, Hlavná 67/105 (right and left room), and per-voter notices ("Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb", a template for one address); no document on the website or in the Internet Archive says which streets or houses vote in okrsok 1 or 2, so no rules can be written.

507903.name: Hamuliakovo
507903.note: The new website's 'Voľby do NR SR 2023' page has only the two OVK minutes; the old website's NR SR 2023 page (captured 2023-06-12) links only the Speaker's decision calling the election, and the Archive's captured 2023 uploads add only the voter-pass e-mail notice; no okrsky document for this vote was found.

508012.name: Kostolište
508012.note: The website has election pages for 2022, EP 2024 and 2026 only; no page or document of this vote (NR SR 2023 / president 2024); the notice board shows only current items. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

508021.name: Kuchyňa
508021.note: The municipality's website (obeckuchyna.sk) keeps election pages for 2018, 2020, 2024 and 2026 but none for the National Council election of 2023 or the referendum of January 2023; its notice-board archive and full-text search find no okrsky document of 2023. The 2024 documents (súp. č. 0-300 / 301-1480, from 24.1.2024) are later votes' and not allowed here. The Internet Archive has a capture of the 2023 homepage (20230924185726), but web.archive.org stayed offline (connection failures, then 503 'Temporarily Offline') over ~16 attempts with 30-60 s pauses, so the 2023 site could not be searched there.

508136.name: Nová Dedinka
508136.note: The archived 2017 elections page (Voľby VÚC 2017) links no okrsky document. Every okrsky notice Nová Dedinka published (2022 municipal/regional: download_file_f.php?id=1718007, 1720353; 2024 presidential: id=1879554) only says the village has 2 okrsky, both in the Základná škola, Hlavná 45 (okrsok 1 'trieda vpravo', okrsok 2 'trieda vľavo'), with no streets or parts. Both polling stations lie in the same building in part Dedinka pri Dunaji, so not even a part-per-station assignment can be inferred; no document assigns addresses to okrsky.

508217.name: Senec
508217.note: The city's current website keeps only the 2022 and 2026 elections; the Internet Archive kept the old website's okrsky decisions for the presidential and EP elections of 2019, the NR SR election 2020 and the presidential election 2024, but none for this vote.

508292.name: Veľký Biel
508292.note: All files of the notice board (data/uredni_deska/obsah1..514; scans OCR-read) and its election folders were checked: okrsky documents exist only for the elections of 2022 (obsah191_7) and of 24.10.2026 (obsah511/515); for this vote there is none (only voter information, delegation addresses and commission minutes).

508306.name: Viničné
508306.note: The old website (archiv.vinicne.sk) ends in June 2019; the new website (Webygroup) shows only the 2026 municipal elections' documents on its elections page, and the Internet Archive has no capture of an okrsky notice for this vote (only the commissions' minutes for 2024). No document of this vote found.

508519.name: Čerín
508519.note: The live úradná tabuľa of cerin.sk reaches back only to about 2024; its only okrsky notices are for the 2024 presidential election (25.01.2024), the 2024 EP election (07.03.2024) and the municipal/regional elections of 24.10.2026 (29.07.2026), each listing okrsok 1 Čerín and okrsok 2 Čačín. The Internet Archive CDX API returned some results once, then stayed offline (504 / connection failures) over several retries with pauses, so archived pages of this vote could not be checked.

508659.name: Hrochoť
508659.note: The obec's website (hrochot.sk) keeps no okrsky document for this vote: its elections page and the aktuality of the months before the vote (all 33 pages read) hold only other notices; the notice board keeps no older items. The Internet Archive was offline (HTTP 503 'Temporarily Offline') on repeated tries, so archived copies could not be checked.

508772.name: Michalová
508772.note: The 2023 elections page lists only the decree 204/2023 and the okrsok minutes, no okrsky document. The Internet Archive was offline (Temporarily Offline) on repeated attempts.

508888.name: Pohronská Polhora
508888.note: The vote's page has the mayor's decision forming 'dva okrsky' with polling rooms only (both in the obecný úrad, Hlavná 62); no streets per okrsok and the obec has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

508900.name: Polomka
508900.note: Every Polomka okrsky document found (2022 municipal/regional letter of 1.8.2022, NRSR 2023 decision of 26.6.2023, EP 2024 decision of 22.2.2024, referendum 2026 notice) only creates 3 okrsky and gives each the same polling station (Základná škola, Komenského 34); none names streets or parts per okrsok. 3 okrsky vs 2 parts with one shared station, so no part inference is possible. The 2023 NRSR decision lists stations only.

508977.name: Sebedín-Bečov
508977.note: The notice board (all 11 pages, 165 items) has no item for the NR SR election of 2023. Internet Archive CDX for sebedinbecov.sk returned 504 / timed out on repeated tries.

509159.name: Čierne
509159.note: The NR SR 2023 document (Informácia – volebné okrsky, 12.06.2023) only names the polling stations, as does the referendum 2023 one. Every okrsky document of Čierne found (referendum 2023 of 10.11.2022, NR SR 2023 of 12.06.2023, president 2024 of 22.01.2024, EP 2024 of 15.02.2024, referendum 2026 of 21.04.2026, OSO/VÚC 2026 of 07.07.2026) only names the three polling stations (1: Kultúrny dom Čierne Ústredie 189; 2: škola Čierne Ústredie 183; 3: ZŠ s MŠ Čierne VK 969) and assigns no houses, hamlets or numbers to the okrsky. Čierne has no streets and one part (Čierne) for 3 okrsky, so the okrsky cannot be turned into rules (okrsky not as many as parts).

509213.name: Klokočov
509213.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (NR SR 2023, presidential 2024, EP 2024) name the three okrsky only as "Klokočov", "Klokočov - Klin" and "Klokočov - Hlavice" with their polling rooms; the municipality has 9 parts (Hlavice, Hrubý Buk, Javorová, Klin, Klokočov, Kornica, Riečky, Rybárie, Vrchpredmier) and the notices do not say which parts belong to which okrsok, so the okrsky cannot be drawn.

509230.name: Korňa
509230.note: The website's news on the 2020 NR SR and 2024 presidential elections link only voter information, records of results and the e-mail addresses; the site search finds an okrsky announcement only for the 2022 elections. No okrsky document of this vote found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

509248.name: Krásno nad Kysucou
509248.note: The town's "utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností" (2017, 2018, EP 2019, NR SR 2020, referendum 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026) list only the 6 polling stations, never which parts or houses vote where; the 6 okrsky do not match the 4 parts (the part Krásno nad Kysucou is split), so no rules can be written.

509264.name: Kysucký Lieskovec
509264.note: The website (behind a proof-of-work browser check, passed) keeps election pages only for 2026; the referendum 2026 page lists no okrsky document (only the call, voter information, delegation of commission members, voting pass, results). Nothing for this vote is online. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509299.name: Makov
509299.note: The page of this vote on the website lists no document on the okrsky (only delegation, voter information, results).

509302.name: Nesluša
509302.note: The mayor's okrsky notice for the National Council election of 30 September 2023 (VV2023072 and the election page, 27 June 2023) names just the polling stations (no. 1 Obecný úrad, Nesluša 978; no. 2 Základná škola, Nesluša 837), not which addresses vote in each okrsok. The obec has a single part (Nesluša) and no streets (all 1282 addresses numbered by súpisné číslo), so two okrsky cannot be drawn from polling stations or parts. The Internet Archive's CDX for neslusa.sk answered for 2017 and 2018 (no okrsky document among the captures) but stayed 'Temporarily Offline' / 504 for 2019–2026 after several retries with pauses.

509337.name: Olešná
509337.note: Olešná (obecolesna.sk) publishes per vote an 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov' (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024) that names only the two polling stations, with no extent; the EP 2024 'Informácia' names hamlets per okrsok (1: Sklený vrch, Šulkov Potok, Predná Olešná, Priečnica, Rovňany; 2: Potôčky, Polgrúň, Burkov vrch), which the register does not have as parts or streets (one part Olešná, all addresses by súpisné číslo), so no rules can be written from it. No document for the other votes. Internet Archive offline.

509345.name: Oščadnica
509345.note: Only the announcement of the election and the delegation e-mail address are archived for NR SR 2023; the municipality's okrsky announcements list the 6 okrsky only by polling station, which with one part and no streets cannot be turned into rules.

509400.name: Raková
509400.note: Articles of the NR SR 2023 election on rakova.sk (GDPR notice id 1950, results id 1954) link no okrsky document; scanning article ids 1900–2045 and the site search found none, and the Internet Archive has no 2023 capture of such a page.

509451.name: Skalité
509451.note: Skalité has one part and no streets in the address register (all 1,624 addresses by súpisné číslo); the municipality describes its 4 okrsky (and the 2 obvody, each = two okrsky) only by hamlet names and polling stations, never by house numbers, so no rule of the allowed kinds (street, part, k.ú.) can separate them. The website's elections section keeps only the 2023, 2026 pages; no document of this vote with house numbers was found.

509477.name: Stará Bystrica
509477.note: Stará Bystrica announces for each vote only that it forms 2 okrsky, both voting in the Základná škola Stará Bystrica 548 (classes 1.A/1.B or 3.A/3.B); no document says which houses belong to okrsok 1 or 2 (the register has no streets; its parts Stará Bystrica and Lány do not match the okrsky' voters), so no rules can be written.

509485.name: Staškov
509485.note: No okrsky document of this vote on the website (it keeps election material only from 2026). The okrsky decision Staškov publishes (referendum 2026, 05.05.2026) only creates 2 okrsky with rooms in the same building (vestibul / spoločenská sála OÚ) and gives no territory; the register has one part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509493.name: Svrčinovec
509493.note: No okrsky document of the National Council election of 30 September 2023 on svrcinovec.sk: the site search (okrsk, okrskov, volby, voľby, referendum, urcenie) finds only the elections pages of 2017, 2018 and the 2019 presidential election. The Internet Archive (CDX of svrcinovec.sk 2017–2026, after several retries while it was temporarily offline) holds no okrsky document of this vote: its captures of the notice board attachments do not cover the election announcements, and no elections page of this vote is archived. The decisions of 2017 and 2019 that exist define the okrsky only by kopanice names absent from the register, so they could not be transcribed either. Svrčinovec has no streets and one part (Svrčinovec); every address is a súpisné číslo. The okrsky documents of 2017 and of the presidential election of 2019 (identical lists) define the 3 okrsky only by kopanice/osady names: okrsok 1 U Jurištov, U Skorky, U Mišov, U Katraka, U Krišice, U Hlaváča, U Berka, U Švoľka, U Cyprichov, Pod Grapami, U Puraša, U Privarčáka; okrsok 2 U Kupky, Pod bučky a valy, U Vajdíka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka, U Matiaška, U Blažkov; okrsok 3 U Liščáka, Škradné, Potok a Bordža (polling stations: kultúrny dom, ZŠ, kaplnka na Závrší). None of these names is a street, part or k.ú. of the register, and no source gives their house numbers. Seven of them (U Skorky, U Krišice, U Švoľka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka) are not in ZBGIS geographic names (inspirews.skgeodesy.sk GN) or OSM at all, and the located ones of okrsky 1 and 2 are interleaved all over the village (e.g. Pod Grapami (1) west of Matiaškovci (2), Vajdíkovci (2) beside Jurištovci (1)). Assigning each register address to the nearest located osada gives 691/199/162 addresses for okrsky 1/2/3, against 1199/1294/311 voters on the roll in 2018 (okrsok 2 should be the largest), so the split between okrsky 1 and 2 (in particular of the village centre) cannot be drawn without guessing. Only okrsok 3 (Závršie, Škradné, Potok, separated from the centre) would be clear.

509515.name: Vysoká nad Kysucou
509515.note: The only okrsky document found for these votes (referendum 2023, archived) names each okrsok only by its area and polling station (1 Ústredie, 2 Nižný Kelčov, 3 Vyšný Kelčov), without the parts or houses it covers; the municipality has 8 parts and the part Vysoká nad Kysucou is split between okrsky 1 and 2, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. The website and the Internet Archive hold no other okrsky document for 2017–2026 (the 2026 area descriptions are for the October 2026 elections).

509523.name: Zákopčie
509523.note: This vote's document was found (Vytvorené volebné okrsky ... pre voľby do NR SR 2023, 12 Jun 2023) but it gives no territory: it only creates two okrsky with their polling rooms in the municipal office, naming no parts or house numbers; the village has 6 parts and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be turned into rules. The only okrsky decisions on the village's website are those for the referendum of 21 January 2023 (9 Nov 2022) and the National Council election of 2023 (12 Jun 2023); both only create 'dva volebné okrsky' with their rooms (zasadačka and kancelária č. 1, both in the municipal office) and name no parts, houses or numbers, so no territorial split can be written; the village has 6 parts and no streets, so the parts cannot be inferred from the stations either.

509531.name: Zborov nad Bystricou
509531.note: The 2023 page (2912, posted 2023-06-14) links a PDF whose file has since been overwritten by the 2026 referendum's document; page 3040 (2023-09-29) says only 'Okrsok č. 1 pre Dolný koniec a Okrsok č. 2 pre Horný koniec', both in the school gym. No 2023 referendum okrsky document found. Every okrsky document of the municipality (2019 to 2026, live on its website) names okrsok 1 only 'Dolný koniec' and okrsok 2 only 'Horný koniec', with no house numbers or settlements; the register has a single part (Zborov nad Bystricou), no streets and only súpisné čísla, and both okrsky vote in the same building, so neither parts nor polling stations can place any address: the document cannot be turned into rules. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org) refused connections on every try (several retries with 30-60 s pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509582.name: Bobrov
509582.note: All files of the notice board (data/uredni_deska/obsah1..284) were checked: for the National Council election of 2023 only the decree and the voter information (obsah5_1, obsah6_1) are there, no okrsky document; CUET has none.

509728.name: Klin

509795.name: Liesek

(as in the other documents)

518271.name: Detvianska Huta

Nothing for this vote. web.archive.org refused connections.

518298.name: Dobrá Niva
518298.note: No okrsky document for this vote: the website's elections section (Voľby a referendá) has pages from 2022 on, and the pages of NR SR 2023, prezident 2024 and EP 2024 list only the decisions, voters' information, forms and commission records; the site search finds no okrsky notice. The old domain dobraniva.sk is now a parked domain with almost nothing in the Internet Archive, and the Archive's CDX query for obecdobraniva.sk timed out.

518425.name: Hontianske Tesáre
518425.note: NR SR election 2023: the page parlamentne-volby-2023.html (archived 2023-06-24) and the new site's 'Voľby 2023' item list voter information, postal voting, decision calling the election, voting certificate, OVK delegation, recorders and results, no okrsky document.

518549.name: Kriváň
518549.note: Kriváň has no streets (all 717 addresses by súpisné číslo). The website (obeckrivan.sk, Voľby a referendum) keeps only the 2026 pages; its documents (2026) define the two obvody/okrsky only as 'Pod traťou' and 'Nad traťou' without listing houses, which cannot be written as street/part/number rules. No document of this vote was found live; the Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

518662.name: Očová
518662.note: No document assigning streets to okrsky for this vote: ocova.sk's elections pages (Voľby a referendum: 2018, EP 2019, NRSR 2020, NRSR 2023, local 2025, referendum 2026) and the Internet Archive's captures (2019 elections pages and files) hold only general voter information, e-mail addresses, results and, for 2025 and the referendum 2026, decisions naming the three polling stations without streets; there is no page for the 2017 regional, 2019 presidential or 2024 EP elections.

518689.name: Pliešovce
518689.note: The municipality's pages for this vote show only results (and for NR SR 2023 the commission minutes); the only okrsky document on the website is the street list for the referendum of 21.01.2023. No okrsky document for this vote was found live or among the Internet Archive's captures.

518701.name: Rykynčice
518701.note: No okrsky notice for this vote on rykyncice.sk, live or in the Internet Archive: the website's elections list starts in September 2022 (the 2023 NR SR page has only the voter information and minutes); the archived pages of 2017–2020 carry only the state's voter information (the 2017 'Voľby' PDF is the VÚC information sheet and announcement). Another vote's notice is not this vote's.

518808.name: Sliač
518808.note: The town's website (elections pages and site search) keeps election documents only of 2022 and 2026; no okrsky document of the NR SR election 2023 was found; Internet Archive offline.

518913.name: Sverepec
518913.note: Sverepec's website (no elections page) shows on its notice board only election zápisnice and candidate lists; no okrsky document for any vote 2017-2026 found live. The Internet Archive (CDX) stayed offline on repeated attempts over ~20 minutes.

518972.name: Zvolenská Slatina
518972.note: The 2023 National Council election page lists the call, voter information, postal voting, delegations and the poster VZN; no okrsky document or 'informácia o čase a mieste', live or in the Internet Archive. The documents of 2022–2026 give the okrsky by streets.

519197.name: Giraltovce
519197.note: The town's decisions on the okrsky (e.g. 3 September 2018, 9 November 2022 for the 2023 referendum, 4 May 2026 for the 2026 referendum) list the 3 okrsky only by number and polling station (all on Dukelská), with no streets or houses; the town has 2 parts (Giraltovce, Francovce), so the 3 okrsky cannot be drawn from them, and no street list of the okrsky was found.

520098.name: Čabalovce
520098.note: No official website of the village was found (cabalovce.sk and obeccabalovce.sk do not resolve; web search finds only aggregators). The village has no street names and one part, so its 2 okrsky could only be told apart by an official list of súpisné čísla, which was not found. Internet Archive offline.

520829.name: Stakčín
520829.note: The website (stakcin.eu; stakcin.sk does not resolve) publishes for each vote only 'Určenie volebnej miestnosti' (e.g. 23.6.2023 NR SR, 29.1.2024 president) giving one polling station for both okrsky č. 1 and č. 2, without streets; the obec has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. No page or document for the other votes.

521299.name: Čaňa
521299.note: The live website keeps election pages only for 2026 (referendum and the autumn 2026 elections); the notice board has no okrsky document of this vote. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org CDX API) stayed offline (HTTP 503 / connection failures) for over 20 minutes of retries with pauses, so archived pages of earlier votes could not be searched.

521302.name: Čečejovce
521302.note: The notice board (items 1–645 checked) has no okrsky item for the NR SR election 2023 (only the results/minutes item); item 430 of mid-2023 no longer exists. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

521493.name: Jasov
521493.note: The official website www.jasov.sk (host 46.28.107.238) refused every connection from us, and so did the Internet Archive; the old site obecjasov.sk was last updated in 2015 and has no elections documents. No document could be read; the maintainer may retry.

521523.name: Kecerovce
521523.note: All notice-board articles of the website (ids 900-1350, incl. the ones migrated from the old site) were checked: for this vote there are only information for voters, the decree calling it, delegation notices or results; no "utvorenie volebných okrskov" document. The only okrsky document is that of the elections of 24.10.2026. CUET has none.

521639.name: Kysak
521639.note: Kysak's okrsky documents (určenie volebných okrskov of 29.7.2022, 19.6.2023, 23.1.2024; the other votes' pages in the Internet Archive list none) only create okrsok 1 and 2 with their rooms and say 'Voliči budú zaradení do volebných okrskov podľa súpisného čísla' without giving which súpisné numbers go where, so no rules can be written. The only split found is the 2017 voter rolls per okrsok (Okrsok_1/2_KSK2017.pdf, names with súpisné numbers), captured only in 2025 and not naming the vote, so not datable as the 2017 document. The website itself refuses connections from here.

521655.name: Malá Ida
521655.note: The obec's only document for the NR SR election of 30.9.2023 ('Určenie okrskov a volebnej miestnosti', 15.06.2023) says only that it forms 2 okrsky in the Kultúrny dom, Letná 7; no streets. The notices 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb' give only the okrsok number per voter.

521671.name: Medzev
521671.note: Medzev's live website (medzev.sk, Voľby a referendá and úradná tabuľa, all pages) now shows only the documents of the elections of October 2026; the okrsky documents of earlier votes are gone. The Internet Archive, where they might be kept, refused connections (offline) during the search.

521931.name: Rozhanovce
521931.note: The website (rozhanovce.com; the old rozhanovce.sk does not resolve) keeps only notices for 2023 NR SR, 2024 and the 2026 referendum, which give the number of okrsky (2) and their rooms (Kultúrny dom, veľká / malá sála) but no streets or house numbers; both stations are in the same building, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. Nothing for earlier votes is online. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

521973.name: Seňa
521973.note: The NR SR 2023 document (26.06.2023) names only the polling stations of okrsok 1 and 2, both in Kultúrny dom Seňa 148, with no house numbers. Seňa has one part and no streets; okrsky can be drawn only from house-number ranges, which only the documents of the 2019 presidential election and the 2024 EP election give.

522279.name: Michalovce
522279.note: The 2023 NR SR section has only the okrsky's records of results; no notice of the okrsky with their streets was found.

522376.name: Budkovce
522376.note: The live Voľby page lists for NR SR 2023 only the announcement, voter information, e-mail notices and the commissions' records; no okrsky notice.

522872.name: Pavlovce nad Uhom
522872.note: Pavlovce nad Uhom's website (pavlovce.sk) has a page per vote (2018, NR SR 2020, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026) but they link only information for voters and the commissions' minutes, no document on the okrsky (the 2017 and 2019 votes have no page). The host rate-limits (HTTP 429); the Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

523101.name: Strážske
523101.note: NR SR election 2023: the pages give voter information and the OVK delegation contact only, no okrsky.

523488.name: Hôrka
523488.note: The website keeps only a 'VOĽBY 2026' page (October 2026 elections); its notice board shows only current items and the site map and search show no earlier election page or okrsky document. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

523798.name: Rakúsy
523798.note: No okrsky document of this vote was found on the website or in the Internet Archive (only the 2018 and 2024 notices, which give no addresses). Rakúsy has no streets and one register part (all 478 addresses numbered by súpisné číslo); its two okrsky are the village (okrsok 1) and the Roma settlement (osada, okrsok 2). The documents found name only that split and the polling stations, never which súpisné čísla belong to the osada, so no rule can place the addresses.

523925.name: Svit
523925.note: No document of this vote that assigns streets to okrsky found. Street lists were found only for the presidential elections of 2019 and 2024.

524000.name: Veľká Lomnica
524000.note: The current website has pages only for the 2026 votes. The 2017 okrsky PDF (Volebneokrskyavolebnemiestnostizv.28.8.2017.pdf) linked from the archived 2017 elections page is gone live (404) and not in the Internet Archive; the archived 2019 'okrsky podľa ulíc' pages keep no text or attachment (the EP 2019 file download_file_f.php?id=1088171 is 404 live and not archived); no okrsky document for 2018, 2020, 2023 or 2024 was found live or archived. The Internet Archive was intermittently unreachable (retried).

524603.name: Jarovnice
524603.note: The current elections page starts with the 2024 presidential election; in the Internet Archive the 2017 regional, 2019 presidential and 2019 EP pages carry only the call of the elections, voter information and candidate lists, and no okrsky decision for the 2023 referendum or the NR SR 2023 election is archived.

525618.name: Dedinky
525618.note: No okrsky document for this vote: the website keeps only current notices and the council archive, and the Internet Archive's captures of dedinky.eu have election notices only for the referendum of 2023 and the 2022 elections (an archived 2019 'Oznámenie o čase konania volieb' page has no text or file).

525634.name: Dobšiná
525634.note: No retrievable okrsky document of this vote. 525685.name: Gemerský Sad
525685.note: The notice board items (--23-1 … --23-186 enumerated) hold for elections only OVK minutes (EP 2024, referendum 2026) and the 2026 municipal notices; no okrsky document of this vote; the 2022 okrsky item (--23-141) has been removed. 525944.name: Magnezitovce
525944.note: No okrsky document for the National Council election of 30 September 2023 found: the live notice board (uradne.sk portal, back to 2023) lists for this vote only voter information and the commissions' minutes; the Internet Archive (online) holds no okrsky notice of it.

526002.name: Muránska Huta
526002.note: The website is unreachable (connection refused); in the Internet Archive the okrsky notices for the presidential and EP 2024 elections give only the two polling stations (Obecný úrad, Muránska Huta č. 2; OLUP n. o., Predná Hora č. 126) without the houses of each okrsok, and the municipality has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. 526045.name: Nižná Slaná
526045.note: The website (elections section from 2022 on, full-text search) has no okrsky document of the NR SR election 2023; Internet Archive offline.

526282.name: Slavošovce
526282.note: The mayor's documents found (prezident 2019, EP 2019, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024, EP 2024) give each of the 2 okrsky only its polling station (obecný úrad / budova č. 113; materská škola), with no streets or house numbers; the municipality is one part with no streets, so the okrsky cannot be placed. For this vote (2023 NR SR) only such a document exists.

526291.name: Stratená
526291.note: All files of the notice board (data/uredni_deska/obsah1..360) and the election pages were checked: the only okrsky/obvody document is that of the elections of 2022 (obsah160_2); for this vote there is none. web.archive.org was unreachable (connection refused) when checked.

526509.name: Gelnica
526509.note: The NR SR 2023 elections page (https://www.gelnica.sk/parlamentne-volby-2023-.html) is gone live (404); its only capture (20230620115407) shows the decision calling the vote and voter information, not yet the okrsky. Of the untitled PDFs the Archive captured 2023-06..09 (download_file_f.php), 37 were listed; those fetched contain no okrsky decision; IA stayed slow/refusing for: none.

526533.name: Harichovce
526533.note: The okrsky notice (https://www.harichovce.sk/data/page/harichovce.sk/23203/volebne-okrsky-a-miestnosti.pdf) only says there are two okrsky, both voting in the primary school at Levočská 53 (rooms of class 1 and class 2); it does not say which streets or houses belong to which okrsok. Harichovce has one part, so neither the streets nor a part can be assigned to an okrsok; no rules can be written. The Internet Archive keeps the old site's election pages only from 2021, with the same content.

526657.name: Žehra
526657.note: The notice of this vote describes the two okrsky only by area names ("Žehra centrálna časť, Žehra časť Hodkovce" and "Sídlisko Dreveník, Osada Dreveník") without house numbers; all addresses are numbered by súpisné číslo without streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it.

526762.name: Jakubany
526762.note: The notice board on jakubany.sk (all ~580 entries, 2020-2026) has okrsky notices only for the referendum and the elections of 2026; for this vote nothing.

526975.name: Podolínec
526975.note: Podolínec's notice board (podolinec.eu/uradna-tabula/, articles 'oznamenie-o-utvoreni-volebnych-okrskov...' and variants) now holds only the okrsky announcement of the elections of October 2026; earlier ones are removed. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

527106.name: Svidník
527106.note: No okrsky document of the NR SR election 2023 was found: the website keeps only the 2026 votes, and the Internet Archive has no capture of the vote's elections page or okrsky file.

527840.name: Stropkov
527840.note: The NR SR 2023 page lists only voter information; no okrsky document found live or archived.

528099.name: Trebišov
528099.note: The town's elections pages now cover only 2024 and 2026; no okrsky document of the NR SR election 2023 was found on the website; Internet Archive offline.

528293.name: Čierna nad Tisou
528293.note: The city's elections section has an okrsky notice only for the presidential election 2024 and the municipal elections of October 2026; the EP 2024 page links no document, and nothing older is on the website or found in the Internet Archive.

528463.name: Krišovská Liesková
528463.note: The obec's current website (new CMS) holds only 2026 election pages; no okrsky document for this vote found live or by web search. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org, incl. the CDX API) refused connections throughout (about 45 minutes, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

528471.name: Kuzmice
528471.note: The website's elections documents (2022 on) contain one okrsky document, for NR SR 2023 (20.06.2023), which lists okrsky 1 and 2 both in the Kultúrny dom (Hlavná 286/126, veľká sála) without saying which streets vote where; no other vote has an okrsky document. No rules can be written. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

528510.name: Leles
528510.note: The website's elections pages (2018: obvod, population, candidate notices; EP 2019: delegation notice; 2026) and its notice board (only current items, incl. Referendum 2026: delegation only) contain no okrsky document for 2017-2026 votes; the Internet Archive was offline ('Temporarily Offline') during the search, so archived copies could not be checked.

528587.name: Michaľany
528587.note: No okrsky document for this vote on the municipality's website (election document sections and archive) nor among the Internet Archive's captures of michalany.eu (no okrsky file captured); the only okrsky document found (presidential election 2024) names just two polling rooms at Hlavná 108 without streets.

528625.name: Nový Ruskov
528625.note: No okrsky document of the 2023 National Council election found: the old site (archived July 2023) and the live 'Voľby do NRSR' category have only the delegation notice and the ballots; the live news has the commission's result record.

529133.name: Sečovská Polianka
529133.note: The only document (Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebnej miestnosti pre voľby do NR SR, 30.6.2023) sets 2 okrsky with their polling stations only (Malá sála and Obecná knižnica, both in Kultúrny dom Hlavná 559/56), naming no streets or house numbers; Sečovská Polianka has one part, so the okrsky cannot be placed.

529176.name: Soľ
529176.note: No okrsky document of this vote was found; the archived page 'Volebné okrsky' (Sep 2023) shows no document text. The municipality has one part (Soľ) and no streets; its okrsky documents give each of the 2 okrsky only its polling station (okrsok 1: Základná škola Soľ č. 53, telocvičňa; okrsok 2: the same school, jedáleň), with no house numbers, so no address can be placed in an okrsok.

529222.name: Vechec
529222.note: The official site (obecvechec.sk; vechec.sk returns 403) has election pages only for 2026; the referendum 2026 notice (15.05.2026) names 2 okrsky both voting in the same room (Obecný úrad, Hlavná 133/32 – sála OcÚ) with no streets, and the 2022 notice was the same; Vechec has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The Internet Archive refused connections (CDX) during the search.

529265.name: Zámutov
529265.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (NR SR 2023 of 26.06.2023, president 2024, EP 2024 of 27.02.2024) give only the two polling stations (Komunitné centrum Zámutov č. 41; Základná škola Zámutov č. 531), not which houses vote where; the municipality has one part and no streets, so no rules can be written. No okrsky document of 2017–2020, the 2023 referendum or the 2026 referendum is on the site. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

529346.name: Bratislava-Nové Mesto
529346.note: The district publishes its okrsky with streets only as an entrance list (ZOSTAVA VCHODOV) per vote under bnm.sk/volby/<yyyymm>/ABECEDA.UL/ (vchody_okr_all.pdf and per-letter PDFs); the Internet Archive kept those PDFs only for June 2024, and the live old site redirects to the home page. For the NR SR election 2023 only the index page (bnm.sk/volby/202309) is archived; no street/entrance list survives.

529401.name: Bratislava-Devín
529401.note: devin.sk (new moderneobce site since 2023) keeps only the 2026 vote pages (referendum 4.7.2026 and municipal elections 24.10.2026, both with one okrsok); pages of earlier votes are deleted (enumerated page IDs 18200-31600: no other vote page). CUET lists no okrsky document of Devín (2023-2026 entries only). web.archive.org refused connections throughout (retried many times over ~30 min), so archived 2018-2024 documents could not be checked; IA offline.

542717.name: Bojná
542717.note: The website has election pages only for NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024 and 2026; none holds an okrsky list for this vote (EP 2024 only says "2 volebné okrsky", one room in the Kultúrny dom). Fetched slowly because of HTTP 429 rate limits. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

542938.name: Horné Obdokovce
542938.note: The 2023 National Council election page is gone live (404); its archived copy (2024-07-21) lists only the OVK minutes of okrsky 1 and 2. No document of this vote and none of the referendum of 21 January 2023 (its page referendum-2023.html is gone and was never archived). The only okrsky document the website has (live and archived) is the mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of the elections of 29 October 2022 (download_file_f.php?id=1734793, posted 4.8.2022: okrsok 1 Bodok and Horné Obdokovce, okrsok 2 Obsolovce), which is another vote's document. The Internet Archive answered only intermittently (often 'Temporarily Offline' or connection refused) but its CDX lists were obtained; it holds no okrsky document of this vote. The live host rate-limited (HTTP 429) part of the time.

543004.name: Chynorany
543004.note: The archived notice board (2023-07-15) lists, under 'Voľby do NR SR 2023', a notice 'Volebné okrsky' (published 19.6.2023) whose preview reads 'V Obci Chynorany boli utvorené 2 volebné okrsky a určené 2 volebné mi…'; the notice page itself was never archived (CDX and wayback/available empty) and is gone from the live site (the URL now shows the home page), so its okrsky cannot be read. The Internet Archive (CDX of chynorany.sk, all URLs 2017–2026) was searched for election pages, notice-board captures and the archived PDFs near each vote. Web search with the input queries found nothing either. The Internet Archive was reachable (its CDX API timed out at first, then answered).

543047.name: Klátova Nová Ves
543047.note: The website (úradné oznamy, 'Voľby 2026 - informácie', site search for okrsky/okrsok/volebné obvody/referendum) holds election notices of October 2026 only, plus old results (NR SR 2016, EP); no okrsky document of this vote. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

543322.name: Margecany
543322.note: Margecany's okrsky decisions found (prezident 2024: 23.1.2024; referendum 2026: 24.4.2026) only create okrsky č. 1 and č. 2 and name their polling rooms (rooms 102 and 109 in the same obecný úrad building); they assign no streets, houses or parts to either okrsok, and the municipality has a single part, so no rules can be written or inferred. The live elections pages for 2017-2020 are empty and no other okrsky document of 2017-2026 is on the live site. The Internet Archive was offline (Temporarily Offline / empty CDX) throughout repeated retries over ~15 minutes, so archived pages could not be checked.

543373.name: Nálepkovo
543373.note: The website's okrsky notices (referendum 2023 of 10.11.2022, president 29.1.2024, EP 5.3.2024) only create two okrsky voting in one room (zasadacia miestnosť OcÚ) without saying which addresses vote in which; no rules can be written from them. The board and elections pages go back only to 2022. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

543497.name: Prakovce
543497.note: The site search for 'okrskov', 'okrsky', 'okrsok', 'miestností', 'volieb' lists okrsky documents only for 2017 (id=876391), 2018 (id=1011032), 2022 (id=1717407) and 2026 (id=2398726, now 404); none for this vote. The elections pages of this vote are not on the live site; the Internet Archive CDX was offline/timing out.

543519.name: Rudňany
543519.note: No document assigning houses to the two okrsky found. The municipality's okrsky decisions (rudnany.sk, Voľby: referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024) only name the two polling stations (ZŠ s. č. 96; obecný úrad s. č. 234); the pages of 2018-2020 and of the referendum 2026 carry no okrsky notice.
